summary: Q2 2026 revenue was $904.4 million, up 35.3% year over year; Software & Services grew 36.2% and Connected Devices grew 34.6%.
source: Axon Q2 2026 Form 8-K shareholder letter and Form 10-Q
analyst_note: Growth remains broad-based rather than dependent on a single product line.

summary: ARR reached $1.639 billion, up 39% year over year, while net revenue retention reached 126%.
analyst_note: NRR and ARR are strong evidence of expansion within existing customer relationships.

summary: Future contracted bookings reached $15.1 billion and GAAP remaining performance obligations were approximately $9.8 billion at June 30, 2026.
source: Axon Q2 2026 Form 8-K shareholder letter and Form 10-Q
analyst_note: Bookings are broader than GAAP RPO and remain subject to cancellation and appropriation terms.

summary: First-half 2026 operating cash flow was negative $11.4 million and free cash flow was negative $55.6 million.
source: Axon Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and shareholder letter
analyst_note: Receivables, contract assets and inventory absorbed substantial cash during rapid growth.

summary: Stock-based compensation was $278.7 million in first-half 2026 and full-year 2026 guidance is $590-$620 million.
source: Axon Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and Form 8-K shareholder letter
analyst_note: Adjusted EBITDA excludes this major shareholder economic cost.

summary: Shares outstanding increased from 76.62 million at year-end 2024 to 80.21 million at year-end 2025 and 81.24 million at June 30, 2026.
analyst_note: Per-share value creation must outrun continuing dilution.

signal: XSP and CEO award dilution capacity
summary: The Employee XSP has an approved pool of approximately 4.5 million shares with about 0.9 million XSUs available to grant at June 30, 2026; the CEO Performance Award covers 679,102 XSUs.
analyst_note: Performance hurdles improve alignment but do not eliminate dilution cost.

summary: Q2 Software & Services gross margin was 71.3%, adjusted gross margin was 75.1%, and management stated software-only gross margin remained above 80%.
analyst_note: The software layer supports long-run margin potential if mix and professional-services costs normalize.

summary: International and enterprise bookings each approximately tripled year over year, while AI Era, Axon 911 and counter-drone offerings added new growth vectors.
analyst_note: These markets extend duration beyond the mature U.S. state-and-local public-safety core.

summary: Cash, restricted cash and short-term investments were about $685 million versus $1.75 billion of senior-note principal, resulting in roughly $1.1 billion net debt; the $300 million revolver was undrawn.
source: Axon Q2 2026 Form 10-Q and Form 8-K shareholder letter
analyst_note: Liquidity is adequate, but leverage plus negative first-half cash flow reduces balance-sheet flexibility versus a net-cash profile.

summary: Axon acquired the remaining interest in Carbyne for approximately $551.7 million of cash and recorded approximately $523.3 million of goodwill under the current purchase-price allocation.
analyst_note: Strategic fit with 911 is credible, but acquisition ROIC and cross-sell benefits remain unproven.

summary: President Joshua Isner sold 16,775 shares on August 31, 2026 under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted June 1, 2026 and retained approximately 296,974 shares after the reported transactions.
analyst_note: Pre-arranged sale and substantial remaining ownership limit its negative signal value.

summary: Recent dispositions reported by Isaiah Fields, Elizabeth Reid Coughlin, Cameron Brooks and Jennifer Mak were shares withheld to settle tax liabilities on vested restricted stock units.
analyst_note: These F-code transactions should not be interpreted as discretionary bearish insider selling.

summary: At a $538.15 reference price, market capitalization is approximately $43.7 billion and enterprise value approximately $44.9 billion, equating to about 12.1x midpoint 2026 revenue and 47.6x guided adjusted EBITDA.
source: Latest confirmed market close retrieved for 2026-09-03 plus Axon 2026 guidance
analyst_note: Valuation leaves limited margin for ordinary execution.

summary: Reverse valuation suggests the current price requires roughly 18%-20% annual revenue growth for ten years assuming terminal owner-FCF margin of 20%-22%, 1.5% annual dilution, a 10% discount rate and a 25x-30x terminal multiple.
source: Investment Harness analyst model based on Axon filings and current reference price
analyst_note: The requirement is achievable only if growth duration, margin conversion and dilution control remain exceptional.

summary: 고객 유지·제품 확장은 지지하나 계약 총액은 취소 불가능한 확정 매출과 다르다. 기존 owner-FCF와 연간 희석률이 같은 SBC 비용을 중복 반영했을 가능성을 확인했다. 총점은 유지하되 기존 504달러 Base를 확정 내재가치로 사용하지 않는다.
analyst_note: 과거 충돌 주장은 삭제하지 않고 역사로 보존. 현행 판단은 동일 날짜 재평가 오버레이가 우선한다.
